question: What is BIS hallmark certification and why is it important?
answer: BIS hallmark is the official certification that guarantees the purity of gold jewellery sold in India. It is issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards and includes the BIS logo, the purity in carats (e.g., 22K916), the jeweller's identification mark, and the hallmarking centre's mark. At Mahalaxmi Jewellery, every piece of gold jewellery above 2 grams is BIS hallmarked, ensuring you receive exactly the purity you pay for. Hallmarking protects you from under-caratage and gives you confidence in your purchase.

question: What gold purities do you offer and which one should I choose?
answer: We offer 24K (99.9% pure), 22K (91.6% pure), and 18K (75% pure) gold. 24K gold is purest but soft, so it is primarily used for investment coins and bars. 22K gold is the most popular choice for jewellery in India as it balances purity with durability — perfect for necklaces, bangles, and earrings. 18K gold is stronger and more scratch-resistant, making it ideal for daily-wear rings and Western-style settings. We recommend 22K for traditional Odia jewellery and 18K for pieces you plan to wear every day.

question: How are making charges calculated on your jewellery?
answer: Making charges cover the labour, craftsmanship, and design effort involved in creating your jewellery. At Mahalaxmi Jewellery, we charge making charges as a percentage of the gold value, typically ranging from 8% to 20% depending on the complexity of the design. Simple daily-wear pieces attract lower charges, while intricate Tarakasi or Temple jewellery pieces with detailed handwork have higher charges. We display making charges transparently on each product, and our certified karigars ensure every rupee you spend on workmanship is justified by the quality of the finish.

question: What is your exchange and buyback policy?
answer: We offer a 100% exchange policy on all gold jewellery purchased from Mahalaxmi Jewellery. You can exchange your old pieces for new designs at any time, paying only the difference in gold value plus making charges on the new piece. For buyback, we repurchase jewellery at the prevailing market rate of gold, deducting a small recycling fee of 3-5%. Silver jewellery is also accepted for exchange. We recommend bringing your original purchase invoice for a smoother transaction. Special promotional pieces may have specific exchange terms mentioned at the time of purchase.

question: Do you create custom or bespoke jewellery designs?
answer: Absolutely. Custom design is one of our specialities. You can bring us a photo, a sketch, or even just a description of what you envision, and our in-house designers will create a 3D rendering for your approval before production begins. We work with you on every detail — gold purity, gemstones, finish, and weight — to create a one-of-a-kind piece that reflects your personal style. The process typically takes 7-21 days depending on complexity, and we offer free consultations at our Balasore showroom.

question: How do the gold savings schemes work?
answer: Our gold savings schemes are designed to help you accumulate gold through affordable monthly installments while earning bonus gold at maturity. You choose a plan (11, 21, or 36 months) and commit to a fixed monthly installment starting from ₹1,000. At the end of the plan, you receive gold equivalent to your total savings plus a bonus of 20-30% based on your chosen scheme. There is no interest involved — the bonus is additional gold we credit to your account. You can take delivery as jewellery, coins, or a combination of both at the prevailing market rate.

question: Do you deliver jewellery and what are the shipping charges?
answer: Yes, we deliver across India through insured and trackable shipments. For orders within Balasore district, we offer free doorstep delivery. for the rest of India, we charge a nominal shipping fee of ₹150, which is waived on orders above ₹50,000. All shipments are securely packed in tamper-proof packaging and fully insured. International shipping is available on request — please contact our store for a quote. We recommend collecting high-value bridal pieces in person, but we can arrange safe delivery if you are unable to visit.

question: What warranty do you offer on your jewellery?
answer: All Mahalaxmi Jewellery purchases come with a lifetime warranty on workmanship defects. This means that if a clasp breaks, a stone falls out from its setting, or a solder point opens under normal wear, we will repair it free of charge for the lifetime of the piece. Our warranty does not cover wear and tear from rough handling, loss of stones due to impact, or alterations made by third-party jewellers. We also provide free professional cleaning and polishing for all our pieces — just visit our Balasore showroom with your purchase invoice.
